items.title: Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
items.summary: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model with 740 million parameters that converts text, images, video, audio, and code into vectors. It runs on-device, needs only about 191 MB of RAM, and outperforms some competing models twice its size, according to Google. Paired with a small open model like Gemma 4, it can run offline RAG apps without sending data to external servers. The article Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據 Google 指出，Google 推出了 EmbeddingGemma 2，這是一個擁有 7.4 億個參數的開放模型，能將文字、圖片、影片、音訊和程式碼轉換為向量。它可在裝置上執行，僅需約 191 MB 的記憶體，且效能超越某些體積大上一倍的競爭模型。搭配像 Gemma 4 這樣的小型開放模型，它可以在不需要將資料傳送至外部伺服器的情況下執行離線 RAG 應用程式。文章〈Google 宣稱 EmbeddingGemma 2 的效能超越體積大上一倍的競爭向量模型〉（The Decoder）率先報導。

items.title: Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure
items.summary: According to the Wikimedia Foundation, rogue OpenAI agents edited wikis without permission, tried to abuse a citation tool as a proxy, and may have caused a partial Wikidata Query Service outage through massive crawling. Wikimedia says AI companies need to take responsibility for their agents instead of pushing the burden onto volunteer editors. The article Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據維基媒體基金會（Wikimedia Foundation）指出，失控的 OpenAI 代理未經許可編輯了維基百科、試圖濫用引用工具作為代理伺服器，並可能透過大規模爬蟲導致 Wikidata 查詢服務部分中斷。維基媒體表示，AI 公司必須為其代理負起責任，而不是將負擔推給志願編輯者。這篇題為「Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure」的文章首先發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade
items.summary: Microsoft published a bearish AI outlook from Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu. He predicts about 1.5 percent GDP growth over ten years and at most five percent of jobs replaced. Bigger models won't move the needle, he argues. What's missing are practical apps that change how work gets done. The article Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 微軟 發表了諾貝爾經濟學獎得主達倫・艾塞默魯（Daron Acemoglu）對人工智慧抱持的悲觀看法。他預測，未來十年的 GDP 成長率大約為 1.5%，且最多隻有百分之五的工作被取代。他認為，更大的模型無法帶來實質改變。真正缺乏的是能夠改變工作方式的實用應用程式。這篇題為 微軟 的文章最先發表在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Mistral Large 4 is Europe's trillion-parameter answer to US models that refuse security work
items.summary: Mistral's Large 4 is the company's biggest model yet, with one trillion parameters trained on its own European infrastructure. In the independent Intelligence Index, the model makes a big leap forward but still falls well short of Claude, GPT-6, and Chinese competitors. Mistral's main pitch is cybersecurity work that closed US models refuse to do. items.title: Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
items.summary: Reflection has released Beam, its first open-weight model. The mixture-of-experts system activates just 23 billion of its 501 billion parameters per token and aims to match GLM 5.2 on coding and reasoning while using three to four times less compute. The strategy against Chinese open-weight rivals like Deepseek and Qwen is efficiency over raw performance. The article Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Reflection 發布了其首款開放權重模型 Beam。這套混合專家系統在每個 token 中僅啟動 501 億個參數中的 23 億個，旨在以少三到四倍的運算量，在編碼和推理能力上媲美 GLM 5.2。其針對 Deepseek 和 Qwen 等中國開放權重競爭對手的策略是效率優先於原始效能。本文「Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China」最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: Researchers at PhAI Labs have expanded Yann LeCun's JEPA architecture to work across seven fields, from robotics to biomedicine. items.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
items.summary: Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, as a public preview. It is a 1.05 trillion parameter Mixture of Experts model with 49 billion active parameters, native image input, and a 1 million token context window, trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. The API is live now; open weights ship end of October 2026. The post Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Mistral AI 已發布綽號為 Le Chonk 的 Mistral Large 4 進行公開預覽。這是一個擁有 1.05 兆引數的混合專家（MoE）模型，具備 490 億個活躍引數、原生影象輸入以及 100 萬個 Token 的上下文視窗，並在 Mistral's 位於歐洲的資料中心使用 3,800 個 輝達 Grace Blackwell GPU 進行訓練。API 現已上線；開源權重將於 2026 年 10 月底發布。這篇題為「Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model」的文章首先發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
items.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Reka 推出了 Rho-1，這是一個從頭開始訓練的 190 億參數全能推理模型。單一網路透過共用的 KV 快取來讀取和生成文字、圖像、影片及機器人動作。其蒸餾版本能在約一秒內回傳 5.3 秒的剪輯。這是一個研究預覽版，目前尚未公開模型權重。這篇文章 Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields
items.summary: JEPA-Anything splits a JEPA's single latent target into 4 orthogonal factors, each with its own predictor. Tested across 7 domains, it beat matched JEPA baselines on all 10 dynamics tasks and cut Interventional Pong intervention error by 34.8%. The post Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: JEPA-Anything 將 JEPA 的單一潛在目標拆分為 4 個正交因素，每個因素都有自己的預測器。經過 7 個領域的測試，它在所有 10 個動態任務上都擊敗了匹配的 JEPA 基線，並將介入式乓球（Interventional Pong）的介入誤差降低了 34.8%。這篇題為「超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域」的文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode
items.summary: Together AI has released Together Link, a free, MIT-licensed CLI that connects Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps to open models like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3. One install command sets it up, and an Auto router picks a model for each session. Together claims savings of over 50%. The post Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Together AI 全新奨出 Together Link，這是一款免費、採用 MIT 授權的 CLI，它可將 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Pi 以及 Claude 與 ChatGPT 桌面應用程式連線到 Kimi K3 和 GLM 5.3 等開放源模型。只需一個安裝命令即可完成設定，且自動路由器會為每個關暸選擇模型。Together 表示成本可灩省 50% 以上。本文首發於 MarkTechPost，標題為《Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode》。

items_ai.title: Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
items_ai.summary: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model with 740 million parameters that converts text, images, video, audio, and code into vectors. It runs on-device, needs only about 191 MB of RAM, and outperforms some competing models twice its size, according to Google. Paired with a small open model like Gemma 4, it can run offline RAG apps without sending data to external servers. The article Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size appeared first on The Decoder .

Wikimedia says AI companies need to take responsibility for their agents instead of pushing the burden onto volunteer editors. items_ai.summary: Microsoft published a bearish AI outlook from Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu. He predicts about 1.5 percent GDP growth over ten years and at most five percent of jobs replaced. Bigger models won't move the needle, he argues. What's missing are practical apps that change how work gets done. The article Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Reka 推出了 Rho-1，這是一個從頭開始訓練的 190 億參數全能推理模型。單一網路透過共用的 KV 快取來讀取和生成文字、圖像、影片及機器人動作。其蒸餾版本能在約一秒內回傳 5.3 秒的剪輯。這是一個研究預覽版，目前尚未公開模型權重。這篇文章 Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。
